newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London firm ahead of election.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London firm ahead of election.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were higher on Friday afternoon, lifted by a firm close in Tokyo amid hopes the business-friendly Liberal Democratic Party could win a majority in this weekend's general election in Japan.
The Nikkei/Ise 50 index in London was up 0.72 percent or 10.57 points at 1,473.68 points, helped also by the dollar hitting a 33-month high of 112.55 yen.

In Tokyo, the Nikkei 225 had gained 0.88 percent to 21,612.30 points, lifted by optimism about the election and reports a senior LDP official said a five trillion yen supplementary budget should be considered by year-end.
Dealers noted some interest in hi-tech stocks, housing and construction issues.
"It's looking quite healthy ahead of the election and there should be an election rally if the LDP wins," one dealer said.
But another warned that a loss for the LDP was likely to trigger hefty profit-taking.
